_sourcing_notes: Aggregate level-20 BIS character stats per class/spec, captured 2026-09-26 from foreverchanges.pro/fr/bis/<class>[/<spec>] -- a community-maintained WoW Forever BIS gear aggregator (already cross-referenced against Icy Veins' own Level 20 Gear sections and real Wowhead Forever item tooltips for Warrior, which matched closely). Each page equips the site's own top-ranked item per slot (their 'PvE' list, or '/tank' for the 3 tank specs, or '/balance' for Balance Druid) on a level-20 character of the race the site picked (shown in 'race'), and shows the resulting totals directly -- no manual item-by-item summing needed. For most classes the site adds real Classic-era level-20 base stats (no gear) on top of the item bonuses to produce the 'stats' totals below. Two exceptions: Shaman's default race (Dwarf) could not play Shaman in Classic ('Classic n'avait pas de Chaman Nain'), so the site could only show gear-only deltas (marked with '_gear_delta_only': true) -- for those, base stats were added manually using an Orc Shaman (a real Classic-legal Shaman race) base-stat table that is NOT independently verified against a primary source (it was supplied by the user from a Gemini/AI conversation, not from a cited Wowhead/Blizzard reference); this is the one genuinely weak link in the chain and should be replaced if a better source turns up. Conversion ratios needed to turn Strength/Agility into final melee Attack Power / Crit% for the sim (2 AP per Str for Warrior/Paladin/Shaman/Druid, 1 AP per Str for Rogue/Hunter, 1%% crit per 20 Agi for Warrior/Paladin/Shaman/Druid, 1%% per 29 Agi for Rogue, 1%% per 53 Agi for Hunter, spell crit per Int varies 54-60.6 by class) come from a real, verified, cited source: https://www.wowhead.com/classic/guide/classic-wow-stats-and-attributes-overview (checked live 2026-09-26; also independently confirms the sim's existing AP/14=DPS formula and 19%% dual-wield hit penalty are already correct). None of this is wired into wow_dps_sim.py yet.

conversion_ratios.note: ap_per_agi_melee only applies to Feral (Cat Form) Druid, Hunter and Rogue -- other classes get 0 melee AP from Agility (Warrior/Paladin/Shaman get ranged AP from Agi instead, not modeled here since none of their DPS specs are ranged).

base_crit_hit._source: UNVERIFIED against a primary citation -- user-supplied from a Gemini/AI conversation, not from a cited Wowhead/Blizzard/Elitist-Jerks page I could open myself. Partially cross-validated: the Agi-per-crit and Int-per-crit RATIOS quoted alongside these base values (29 Agi/Rogue, 53 Agi/Hunter, 20 Agi/others, 59.5-60.6 Int/casters) exactly match the independently-verified conversion_ratios above, which gives some confidence, but the flat base %% values themselves are not independently confirmed.
base_crit_hit.base_hit_note: 0%% base Hit for every class, no exceptions -- Hit is purely additive from gear/talents/skills, nothing innate.
base_crit_hit.note: Rogue/Hunter/Warrior/Paladin/Shaman start at exactly 0%% melee crit with no Agility -- all of their crit comes from the Agi pool. Druid has a small 0.96%% innate melee crit floor. Spell crit bases vary 0-2.2%% by class before Intellect is added.

warrior_fury.note: Shared list with Arms per Icy Veins; site's weapon pick is a 2H (matches Arms more than Fury dual-wield -- Fury would want 2 one-handers instead, not separately sourced)

mage_fire.note: Site's generic Mage PvE list leans Frost-itemized (+51 frost vs +6 fire); Fire/Arcane specs would ideally want their own school-matched list, not separately sourced
